sentences.ar: كان اسمه نيكولا توسان، بس ما حدا كان بيعرف اسمه.
sentences.en: His name was Nicolas Toussaint, but no one knew his name.

sentences.ar: كانوا يسموه الجرس، لأنه بيمشي على عكازين، وإجريه بتتأرجح زي الجرس.
sentences.en: They called him the Bell, because he walked on two crutches, his legs swinging like a bell.

sentences.ar: ابن عاهرة ماتت، وبعمر خمستعشر سنة، عربية دعست إجريه.
sentences.en: The son of a whore who died, and at fifteen, a cart ran over his legs.
And since then, he begged.

sentences.ar: من قرية لقرية، على عكازيه، وبياكل اللي بيعطوه، وبينام بالإسطبلات.
sentences.en: Village to village, on his crutches, eating what he was given, sleeping in the stables.

sentences.ar: وما كان بيعرف شي غير هيك.
sentences.en: And he knew nothing else.

sentences.ar: ما بيعرف يقرا، ولا يشتغل، ولا يطلب إلا بإيده.
sentences.en: He could not read, or work, or ask except with his hand.

sentences.en: And crawled to it, seized it, and put it under his shirt.
And wanted only to light a fire, to eat it.

sentences.ar: وبنفس اللحظة، صاحب المزرعة طلع، وشاف.
sentences.en: And in that same moment, the farmer came out, and saw.

sentences.ar: وركض عليه، وضربه بعصاه على ظهره، وعلى راسه.
sentences.en: And ran at him, and beat him with his stick on the back, on the head.
And the beggar fell, and tried to defend himself with his crutch.

sentences.en: And the farmhands came, and all beat him.
And tied him, and took him to the village, to the lock-up.
And he did not speak.
He did not know how to speak.
He only stared.
